data.title: Anutin miffed at 2.2% GDP growth forecast
data.description: <p>Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul and Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas have said Thailand's projected 2.2% economic growth this year is still far from satisfactory, arguing that the country should aim for growth of 3-6%.</p>

data.title: Akanat defends energy permanent secretary pick
data.description: <p>Energy Minister Akanat Promphan has defended Chantanon Wannakejohn's appointment as permanent secretary, rejecting claims it was politically motivated.</p>

data.title: Guru's daily horoscope for Aug 19
data.description: The day of the week you were born on can reveal a lot... Read on. ✨= today's motto,⏰ = work, ₿ = money, ❤️ = taken, ⚤ = single

data.title: OCPB ramps up plane seat inquiry
data.description: <p>Prime Minister's Office Minister Supamas Isarabhakdi has ordered the Office of the Consumer Protection Board (OCPB) to broaden its probe into airline overbooking after a passenger was denied boarding despite checking in on time.</p>

data.title: PP urges EC to send senate election case to top court
data.description: <p>The main opposition People's Party (PP) has urged the Election Commission (EC) to refer a case involving alleged collusion in the 2024 Senate election to the Supreme Court, warning that the poll agency's credibility is already "almost gone".</p>

data.title: EEC expansion plan 'must be transparent'
data.description: <p>Opposition leader Natthaphong Ruengpanyawut has called on Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul to ensure transparency over the proposed expansion of the Eastern Economic Corridor (EEC) into Prachin Buri province.</p>

data.title: Thai shuttle stars fly into second round
data.description: <p>Ratchanok Intanon and Pornpawee Chochuwong stormed into the second round of the BWF World Championships 2026 in New Delhi, but men's doubles pair Pakkapon Teeraratsakul and Peeratchai Sukphun bowed out on Tuesday.</p>

data.title: Big purse, big opportunity await nation's rising stars
data.description: <p>The Thailand Professional Golf Association and the All Thailand Golf Tour continue their collaboration by organising two co-sanctioned tournaments with a total prize pool of six million baht this month.</p>

data.title: Time and punishment
data.description: <p>The homecoming ceremony for convicted drug kingpin Laota Saenlee has reignited questions over how a life sentence was reduced to less than 10 years.</p>

data.title: Anutin pitches Asean gateway
data.description: <p>Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has urged Australian businesses to invest in Thailand, touting the nation as a gateway to the 700-million-strong Asean market.</p>

data.title: Swiss citizen hands back lost Ban Chiang artefacts
data.description: <p>A Swiss national has handed over a collection of artefacts believed to be from the Ban Chiang archaeological site in Udon Thani to the Thai embassy in Bern for verification before their return to Thailand.</p>

data.title: Bottlenecks at Suvarnabhumi targeted before high season
data.description: <p>Deputy Prime Minister Suphajee Suthumpun has ordered urgent action to ease bottlenecks facing arriving passengers at Suvarnabhumi International Airport, targeting delays at immigration, baggage collection and on public transport.</p>

data.title: Pardon rules under review
data.description: <p>Critics have questioned the fairness of Thailand's justice system after the early release of former drug lord Laota Saenlee, whose life sentence was reduced to less than 10 years.</p>

data.title: Govt mulls firearms amnesty
data.description: <p>The government is considering allowing people to surrender illegally held firearms without facing criminal charges as part of tighter gun controls.</p>

data.title: France to expel two Iranian diplomats: foreign minister
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Paris will expel two Iranian diplomats posted in France in retaliation for Iran banning two French diplomats in the embassy in Tehran, the French foreign minister said on Tuesday.

data.title: UN atomic watchdog says found tons of nuclear material at Syria site
data.description: DAMASCUS - The head of the UN's nuclear watchdog said Tuesday its inspectors had found several tons of nuclear material in Syria, at a site Damascus reported to the agency last month.

data.title: US moves to open vast tracts of pristine forests to logging
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - President Donald Trump's administration on Tuesday proposed a rule change that would open 44 million acres of wild, undisturbed forest for road construction and logging.

data.title: US sanctions International Criminal Court chief Tomoko Akane of Japan
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - The United States on Tuesday imposed sanctions against International Criminal Court President Tomoko Akane of Japan as part of its campaign against the body that it accuses of being "politicized."

data.title: Angelique Kidjo immortalised on Hollywood Walk of Fame
data.description: LOS ANGELES (UNITED STATES) - Five-time Grammy winner Angelique Kidjo on Tuesday became the first Black African to be honored with a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame.
